BEARISH: META BELOW TREND (1W: -11.93% | 1M: -12.80%) if selling continues; AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -9.66% | 1M: -17.36%) if it fails to stabilize.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Monitor major cross-timeframe divergence and technology weakness, particularly META BELOW TREND (1W: -11.93% | 1M: -12.80%), despite LMT’s sentiment-confirming catalyst.
